newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC Ltd files US$800 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC Ltd files US$800 mln shelf debt.

text.p: Australian miner WMC Ltd said on Tuesday it had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to US$800 million in debt securities.
WMC also said as part of the shelf registration it planned to launch a medium-term note programme of about US$300 million worth of three, five or seven-year notes.
Merrill Lynch would be the lead agent for the programme, offers from which would be made by a written prospectus, WMC said.
WMC is a leading diversified mining company with total assets of approximately A$7.0 billion as at June 30, 1996.
At 1.00 p.m. (0300 GMT) WMC shares were down 18 cents to A$7.95.
